$comment: Generated by scripts/build-spec.mjs from the component sources — do not edit by hand.
name: OptionCard
whenToUse: A one-of choice where each option needs a title, a line of explanation and often a price: plans, verification methods, delivery.
2–5 options that are the main decision on the screen.
Several at once, each needing a sentence (conditions to take into account): `type="multiple"`, with an `exclusive` “None of these”.

anatomy.description: `OptionCardGroup` — a radio group laid out as a grid (2 columns from sm); with `type="multiple"` a group of checkboxes.
helps tell options apart at a glance.
the title is the accessible name, the description is read after it.

do.caption: Each choice needs a sentence — cards give it room.
do.example:
<OptionCardGroup defaultValue="online" aria-label="Delivery method" className="w-full">
  <OptionCard value="online" title="Online gallery" description="Clients view and download photos in their portal." />
  <OptionCard value="prints" title="Prints by mail" description="Phoebe Light Lab prints and ships the order." />
</OptionCardGroup>

dont.caption: Cards for a plain yes/no — a radio pair or switch says it in a line.
dont.example:
<OptionCardGroup defaultValue="yes" aria-label="Send invoice" className="w-full">
  <OptionCard value="yes" title="Yes" />
  <OptionCard value="no" title="No" />
</OptionCardGroup>

a11y: Works like a radio group: one tab stop, arrows move and select.
With `type="multiple"` each card is a checkbox: Tab moves between cards, Space toggles, and the screen reader says “checked” / “not checked”.
Name the group with `aria-label` or a visible heading via `aria-labelledby`.
Don’t put buttons or links inside a card — the whole card is one radio (or checkbox).

props.name: aside
props.description:
Right-aligned detail before the radio dot — typically the option's
price ("$4 / mo"), so each choice shows its cost without opening it.
Announced after the description (it joins aria-describedby).

props.name: excludes
props.description: In a `type="multiple"` group: values that go off when this card comes on, and the other way round ("more-protein" vs "less-protein").

props.name: exclusive
props.description: In a `type="multiple"` group: on, it clears every other card; any other card coming on clears it ("None of these").

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every card in the group.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the new selected values, exclusive rules already applied.
